text:
Lina Gomez: FYI — final-round candidate is arriving same-day for an evening slot, need to confirm travel/rooming + welcome plan (arrive 6:00pm, interview starts 6:30).
Kei Nakamura: who is their local contact? ETA exactly?
Lina Gomez: candidate (Sam I.) flight lands at 5:05pm, cleared customs ~5:30, lga -> office taxi ~25m. I can pick up if needed but would prefer org to cover a ride.
Maya R.: we can offer a rideshare voucher up to $60 or book a car. also do they need a hotel?
Lina Gomez: company covers hotel for out-of-town final loop. Sam asked for something quiet, single night, checkout tomorrow 11am.
Amy Patel: I updated the calendar invite to reflect 6:30pm start + added the travel stipend note. sent the invite to Sam + panel.
Front Desk: Quick heads-up — after 6pm check-in: drop at loading door C, bring photo ID. We'll badge them at the kiosk. Phone on arrival: +1-555-724-9800.
Lina Gomez: thanks. do we have a door or after-hours code?
People Ops Bot: Badge request submitted for Sam Irving. Badge ETA: 20m after check-in. After-hours door access: code expires at midnight. Please confirm who will meet them at door C.
Kei Nakamura: I'll be available at 6:10 — can meet at the lobby and escort. @Lina can you send a calendar invite for 6:05 meet?
Lina Gomez: done — sent 6:05 meet invite to Kei + Amy + Front Desk.
Maya R.: hotel preference? I can book ACME Suites (quiet, corporate rate). approval needed for rate $220/night.
Amy Patel: approve the hotel. Please use corporate card and add the folio link to Sam's itinerary.
Lina Gomez: Sam dietary note: pescatarian + shellfish allergy. Kitchen will prep a boxed dinner: salmon option + vegetarian.
Kei Nakamura: panelists — quick ask: please confirm whether you need a remote dial-in backup. we have Zoom room reserved in case candidate is delayed.
Amy Patel: confirmed panelist list + backup dial-in in invite description.
Front Desk: When Sam arrives, ask them to check in at kiosk and text "Arrived: Sam I." to +1-555-724-9800 so we can expedite badge pickup.
Lina Gomez: reimbursement process for Lyft/Uber if they prefer: have them forward ride receipt to expenses@redwood.ai with subject: "Candidate Travel - Sam Irving - [date]". We'll reimburse within 3 business days.
People Ops Bot: Reminder: create an expense ticket if vendor pay needed. Template: `Expense Type: Candidate Travel; Amount: $XX; Candidate: Sam Irving; Approver: Lina Gomez`.
Maya R.: I'll book hotel now and add confirmation to Sam's Google itinerary. anyone want pickup assignment instead of Kei?
Kei Nakamura: I'm good to do it.
Lina Gomez: perfect — thanks all. I'll DM Sam the meet spot + Front Desk number. :thumbsup:
Amy Patel: added final checklist to the thread: travel voucher sent, hotel confirmed, invite updated, dietary flagged, badge submitted.
Front Desk: Noted — we'll have a printed visitor pass ready. See you tonight.
Lina Gomez: closing the loop — if anything changes ping here or call me directly.
People Ops Bot: This thread will be archived after 7 days per channel retention settings.
